source: Many observers believe that you are too cavalier about the Republican attack machine.
zh: 许多观察家认为您对共和党的攻击机器过于傲慢。

source: Your own biography always plays well.
zh: 你自己的传记总是表现得很好。

source: You've run a couple of ads which have been confusing to voters, more than anything. What do you stand for? What is Bush doing wrong?
zh: 您投放的一些广告最让选民感到困惑。你代表什么？布什做错了什么？

source: It never hurts to remind the voters of your time in the military.
zh: 提醒选民你在军队的时光总没有坏处。

source: It doesn't matter so much how to stack up to Bush -- anything you can do to subliminally convey that you get military matters is helpful.
zh: 如何叠加到布什并不那么重要——你可以做任何事情来下意识地传达你 得到 军事问题很有帮助。

source: Attacking Dan Quayle is a no-brainer. You can't let this terrible choice of running mate go unpunished.
zh: 攻击丹·奎尔是理所当然的。你不能让这个糟糕的竞选搭档选择不受惩罚。

source: What do you have to say about the selection of John Glenn as your running mate?
zh: 对于选择约翰·格伦作为你的竞选搭档，你有什么话要说的？

source: To what extent will you attack George Bush's relationship with Manuel Noriega of Panama?
zh: 您会在多大程度上攻击乔治·布什与巴拿马曼努埃尔·诺列加 (Manuel Noriega) 的关系？

source: I want to see us running ads on TV, criticizing this relationship. Along with Iran-Contra and Dan Quayle, this episode really brings up questions about Bush's competence.
zh: 我希望看到我们在电视上投放广告，批评这种关系。与伊朗门和丹·奎尔一起，这一集确实提出了关于布什能力的问题。

source: We'll criticize this as much as anything else about Bush's campaign.
zh: 我们将像批评布什活动的其他内容一样批评这一点。

source: This isn't a part of our message in this campaign.
zh: 这不是我们在此活动中传达的信息的一部分。

source: John Glenn has served his home state of Ohio well for many years, and we are proud to have him on our national ticket.
zh: 约翰·格伦多年来一直为他的家乡俄亥俄州服务，我们很自豪他能出现在我们的国家竞选组合上。

source: Bush is pummeling you with negative ads. It's good to fight back and stabilize things.
zh: 布什正在用负面广告打击您。反击并稳定局势是好事。

source: Bush is pummeling you with negative ads. You need to fight back and stabilize things.
zh: 布什正在用负面广告打击您。你需要反击并稳定局势。

source: What do you have to say about the selection of Al Gore as your running mate?
zh: 对于选择阿尔·戈尔作为你的竞选搭档，你有什么话要说的？

source: Al Gore was the third-highest vote-getter during the Democratic primaries, and we are proud to have him on the ticket to unite our party.
zh: 阿尔·戈尔是民主党初选期间得票第三高的人，我们很自豪他能团结我们的政党。

source: What do you have to say about the selection of Jesse Jackson as your running mate?
zh: 对于选择杰西·杰克逊作为你的竞选搭档，你有什么话要说的？

source: Attack ads have developed a habit of showing you and Jesse Jackson shaking hands. Do you have any comment?
zh: 攻击广告已养成向您展示的习惯 和 杰西·杰克逊握手。您有何评论？

source: Jesse Jackson was the second-highest vote-getter during the Democratic primaries, and we are proud to have him on the ticket to unite our party.
zh: 杰西·杰克逊是民主党初选期间得票第二高的人，我们很自豪他能团结我们的政党。

source: I'm proud to stand for election with Jesse Jackson as my running mate. Let the so-called attack ads keep coming.
zh: 我很自豪能够与杰西·杰克逊作为我的竞选搭档一起竞选。让所谓的攻击广告继续出现吧。

source: These types of attack ads are meant to distract from the real issues in this campaign. We won't dignify them with a response.
zh: 这些类型的攻击广告旨在分散人们对该活动中真正问题的注意力。我们不会用回应来尊重他们。

source: We will attack the Republican penchant for underhanded racist attacks which they have displayed in this campaign.
zh: 我们将攻击共和党在这次竞选中表现出的不正当种族主义攻击倾向。

source: Jesse Jackson was a controversial choice, even though he did do well in the primaries. Among other things, Jackson is pretty far to the left, even for a Democrat.
zh: 选择杰西·杰克逊颇有争议，尽管他在初选中表现不俗。争议之一是，即便按照民主党人的标准，他的立场也相当左。

source: Jackson's selection was unpopular with some people, but they have to admit that you're a fighter.
zh: 杰克逊的选择不受一些人欢迎，但他们不得不承认你是一名战士。

source: You had to have known such things were coming. It's not good to let attacks go unanswered.
zh: 你一定知道会发生这样的事情。不回应攻击是不好的。
